name: venture-studio-os
description: Venture Studio OS: one shared memory for a team's AI, and the work it runs.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @venture-studio/contracts && npm run build --workspace @venture-studio/core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @venture-studio/api --workspace @venture-studio/worker --workspace @venture-studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.smoke:backend: npm run build --workspace @venture-studio/contracts && npm run build --workspace @venture-studio/core && npm run test --workspace @venture-studio/core && npm run test --workspace @venture-studio/api && npm run test --workspace @venture-studio/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @venture-studio/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @venture-studio/worker
scripts.smoke:web: npm run lint:web && npm run build:web
